title: Statistic Tool

fields.label: Function
fields.value: When used on an ore or a log it tells the estimated price and the size (in studs)

body:
"Harnessing the recent powers discovered deep underneath Ookspace 47, you can now see stats of tons of different types of items and structures."

Description

The Statistic Tool is an item used to measure the price and size of the targeted ore/log and how many units are filled within a schematic.

It costs $32,500 and can be found in the The Oak Depot.

Despite being pretty expensive, it can be a really useful tool.

Trivia

  • This is the 5th most expensive item in the game, the second being the Nuclear warhead, And first being the Packed glass duck.
